fees.notes: Every trade pays a flat commission. Slippage is modelled as a price penalty: buys fill slippage_pct above the quoted price, sells fill slippage_pct below it. To change fees, append a new schedule entry with a future effective_from date; never edit an entry that trades already used, or the fact checker will fail the replay.

fact_check.notes: A quoted price is accepted when an independent source agrees within price_tolerance_pct.
